prompt:
Find out why `$.model.fork` fails in resumed sessions and explain the root cause. Make no code, config, or file changes; this is investigation only.

Context:
- Search the repo for `$.model.fork` calls, and check the generated mods API declarations in `.claude-plugin/types/` for its exact signature and any documented session or state requirements. Treat those declarations as authoritative.
- Compare the resumed-session path with a fresh session. AGENTS.md notes that `session.start` does not run after `/resume`, so any setup the fork depends on may be missing there.
- Run `claude --version` and compare it with the baseline in AGENTS.md (2.1.296).
- If you can reproduce the failure with an existing test or the affected flow, run it without adding new tests, and capture the exact error.

Done when: you can name the root cause with file and line references, quote the error text, and say whether the failure reproduces. Keep working until those checks are complete, then stop and report. Do not propose or apply a fix unless I ask for one, and do not add tests or docs.
result:
I found the root cause and reproduced the failure. One requested check wasn't possible: the generated `.claude-plugin/types/` declarations don't exist in this checkout (they're gitignored), and neither `claude plugin test` nor a headless `--plugin-dir` run created them. So I couldn't quote the official signature or any documented session requirements. Everything below comes from the installed engine's code (`/opt/claude-code/bin/claude`) and a live run.

## Root cause

`$.model.fork` doesn't fork the transcript. It reuses the parameters of the last request the main thread sent to the API, and that copy lives only in the running process's memory. A resumed session reads its messages back from disk, but it has sent no request yet, so the copy is empty and the fork returns `nothing-to-fork`.

In the engine:

- **The fork:** it takes the in-flight request of the current turn, else the saved one. If there is neither, it returns:
  ```
  t(`$.model.fork (${n}): no main-thread request to fork yet`),{isAnswered:!1,reason:"nothing-to-fork"}
  ```
- **Reading the saved request:** returns `null` when `!e.params || e.sessionId !== n`. It's empty in a new process, and it's discarded when the session id changes, as after `/resume` or `/clear` in the same process.
- **Saving it:** happens only when a request goes out with a `repl_main_thread` or `sdk` source. A slash command handled by a mod (`command.run`) sends no request, so `/handoff` as the first thing after a resume has nothing to fork.

This is about the missing request, not about `session.start`. Nothing in the fork depends on mod setup, so `session.start` not running after `/resume` isn't the cause.

**Version:** installed is **2.1.309**; the AGENTS.md baseline is 2.1.296. The 2.1.301 changelog has a related fix:

> Fixed a mod's `$.model.fork` returning `nothing-to-fork` when called before the first response of a new Claude Code process had finished, as in `claude -p` runs and cloud sessions

That covers a fork made while the first request is still running. It doesn't cover a fork made before any request, which is the resumed-session case, so the bug is still there on 2.1.309.

## Repo call sites
- `bws-cockpit/hooks/register.tsx:676` calls `$.model.fork`. Lines 677–683 already fall back to `$.session.messages()` + `$.model.complete`, and the comment at line 677 describes this exact cause.
- `bws-kit/classify-fork.ts:108-129` (`runFork`) has the same fallback. It reaches bws-memory, bws-diagram, bws-enhance, bws-skillgate and bws-direction through their copies of the kit (e.g. `bws-memory/hooks/register.tsx:121`).
- Recorded before: `runs/2026-10-02-handoff-model-pin/RUNLOG.md` ("Run 1 failed … the resumed session had nothing to fork") and `AGENTS.md:135`.

## Reproduction: yes, live on 2.1.309
I worked in a scratch copy of bws-cockpit and a scratch folder, not the repo:
1. `claude -p "Reply with the single word: ready" --plugin-dir …/bws-cockpit` replied `ready`.
2. `claude -p --continue "/handoff" --plugin-dir …/bws-cockpit --debug-file …` gave this, at line 640 of the debug log:
   ```
   [DEBUG] $.model.fork (bws-cockpit): no main-thread request to fork yet
   ```
   The fallback then worked: `Handoff written: runs/2026-10-23-handoff/HANDOFF.md (284 words).`

So the fork itself fails, and the mods hide it with the fallback.

**Existing tests** (`claude plugin test` in the scratch copy): 160 pass, 65 fail. The resumed-session test, `/handoff > a resumed session (nothing to fork) builds the handoff from the transcript rows` (`bws-cockpit/tests/handoff.test.ts`), fails with `ENOENT …/bws-cockpit/C:/proj/runs`. That's environmental: the tests use Windows `C:/` paths that don't resolve on this Linux host, so the failure says nothing about the fork. The other two nothing-to-fork and API-error `/handoff` tests pass.

Unrelated: validation also warned that `/dashboard` is a name Claude Code ships, so its `$.command.register` call is refused and that hook is skipped.

The worktree is clean (`git status` shows nothing). The scratch copy, the test output and the debug log are in `/tmp/claude-0/-tmp-claude-0--home-user-bws-claude-mods-dev-760f7ba1-34a3-5ceb-b711-31332de7c2eb-scratchpad-wt-investigate--old--opus/296e22c0-0280-46d4-80e6-759b9641a62c/scratchpad/`.
